# Tab 1

I want to keep the fighting mechanics simple anyways two buttons fight and to heal then when you click the fight button theres a tv screen that pops up buttons appear and you have to click them fast because theres a timer ticking down in the corner, when the timer is over the time to attack is done. The faster you click these buttons and the more you click the more damage you do. What i want is there to be phases to the button patterns, so theres three types of weapons slashing blunt and regular. Slashing has buttons forming a sorta arch blunt has them grouped together in multiples of two so like theres 2 buttons on screen or theres 4 or 6 or 8 and regular is just randomly scattered buttons. Theres a timer ticking down to maybe 10 seconds (the seconds you get to click the button depends on the type of weapon) and so when 5 seconds is complete another set of buttons appear and the old ones disapear.

Remember those are only weapon TYPES so there is gunna be weapons that have that class like a hammer, a wrench a metal pipe those are all gunna have the typing of blunt but have different damage output different generated button layouts and different amounts of time you get to press the buttons.

# SCAVENGING

SCAVENGING

\!\!\!\!\! have it be a timed event gives you 20 seconds too look around 3 images and find shit in them wheres waldo style 

You switch  between the images with buttons on the side or soemtnihgn 

(FOR NOW THIS IS HOW ITLL WORK)

1. You go into a place- a gas station wtv and it fades into a bg that shows a room   
2. Once you go into a scavenging event a timer in the corner starts lets say fifteen seconds theres also 2 things in the corner that count the amount of food you have   
3. You look around the room to try and find food and water the buttons are random cans of food and weapons.   
4. When you click on a weapon it pops up a animation thing showing the weapon heres a example thing  we just have the option to equip the weapon or leave it it when you first pick up the weapon ( we can have this screen pause the timer or not so the player is more rushed\!) the description of how the weapon works will be on the side of the thing that shows the weapon\! When you leave it it puts the weapon back where you put it so if you find a stick decide to leave it then go to another room but then decide you actually do want the stick you can go back and pick it up) that way it makes you have to manage your time better while looking for weapons\!\!  
   ![][image67]  
5. When you pick up food it doesnt show a animation or image it just plays a sound effect \!   
6. Once the timer is done it says congrats you got this (then it shows the foodr you got and ofc your weapon.)   
7. Then the story continues on and wtv meow meow
